segments.text: The firſt is this, All the rules and helps in the world will do us little good except we get a good temper within in our hearts; you can never make a ſhip go ſteady with propping of it without, you know there muſt be ballaſt within the ſhip, that muſt make it go ſteady: And ſo there is nothing without us that can keep our hearts in a ſteady conſtant way but that that is within us, grace is within the ſoul and that will do it.
